# Progressive unlock tiers tied to Roman Reconquest (var:oe_rr_count) and Restoration (rome_reconquista_is_end).
oe_prf_tier_1_ok = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = oe_rr_count var:oe_rr_count >= 3 }
        has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end
    }
}
oe_prf_tier_2_ok = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = oe_rr_count var:oe_rr_count >= 6 }
        has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end
    }
}
oe_prf_tier_3_ok = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = oe_rr_count var:oe_rr_count >= 10 }
        has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end
    }
}

# Subject classification for Sacrum Consistorium (oe_byz_policy_org) enrollment.
oe_prf_subject_real_power = {
    oe_subject_of_phoenix_empire = yes
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_ar_exarchate
        AND = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_theme_status var:oe_theme_status >= 3 }
    }
}
oe_prf_subject_client = {
    oe_subject_of_phoenix_empire = yes
    NOT = { oe_prf_subject_real_power = yes }
    OR = {
        is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub
        is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II
        is_subject_type = oe_roman_march
        is_subject_type = oe_hungarian_dominion

    }
}

# Overmighty Exarch crisis condition: at least one Military Prefecture + strain >= 45 or stability < 25.
oe_prf_can_trigger_crisis = {
    oe_prf_mil_prefectures >= 1
    OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain var:oe_ar_strain >= 45 }
        stability < 25
    }
